sources: Charak, Elements of Vedic Astrology — ch. X (Vargas or Subtle Divisions).
Sutton, The Essentials of Vedic Astrology — Vargas, The Divisional Charts.

vargas.name: Rashi
vargas.reads: the body and the whole life; every other varga is read against it

vargas.name: Hora
vargas.rule: In an odd sign the first half is the Sun's hora (Leo), the second the Moon's (Cancer); reversed in an even sign.

vargas.name: Drekkana
vargas.reads: siblings, courage, the nature of effort
vargas.rule: First third: the same sign. Second third: the 5th from it. Third: the 9th from it.

vargas.name: Chaturthamsha
vargas.rule: From the sign itself, then the 4th, 7th and 10th from it.

vargas.name: Saptamsha
vargas.rule: Odd signs count from the sign itself; even signs count from the 7th from it.

vargas.name: Navamsha
vargas.reads: the spouse, dharma, and the underlying strength of every graha
vargas.rule: Movable signs start from themselves, fixed signs from the 9th, dual signs from the 5th.
vargas.note: The single most important varga after D1. A graha strong in D1 but weak in D9 promises more than it delivers.

vargas.name: Dashamsha
vargas.reads: career, profession, action in the world
vargas.rule: Odd signs start from themselves; even signs start from the 9th from the sign.

vargas.name: Dwadashamsha
vargas.rule: Counted from the sign itself, twelve in order.

vargas.name: Shodashamsha (Kalamsha)
vargas.rule: Movable signs start from Aries, fixed from Leo, dual from Sagittarius.

vargas.name: Vimshamsha
vargas.reads: spiritual practice, upasana, and religious inclination
vargas.rule: Movable signs start from Aries, fixed from Sagittarius, dual from Leo.

vargas.name: Chaturvimshamsha (Siddhamsha)
vargas.rule: Odd signs start from Leo, even signs from Cancer.

vargas.name: Bhamsha (Nakshatramsha)
vargas.reads: general strengths and weaknesses; physical stamina
vargas.rule: Fire signs start from Aries, earth from Cancer, air from Libra, water from Capricorn.

vargas.name: Trimshamsha
vargas.reads: misfortunes, evils, and the specific nature of difficulty
vargas.rule: Odd signs: Mars 0-5, Saturn 5-10, Jupiter 10-18, Mercury 18-25, Venus 25-30. Even signs reverse the order.

vargas.name: Khavedamsha
vargas.reads: auspicious and inauspicious effects; maternal legacy
vargas.rule: Odd signs start from Aries, even signs from Libra.

vargas.name: Akshavedamsha
vargas.reads: general conduct and character; paternal legacy
vargas.rule: Movable signs start from Aries, fixed from Leo, dual from Sagittarius.

vargas.name: Shashtiamsha
vargas.reads: past-life karma; the finest resolution in the chart
vargas.rule: Multiply the degrees within the sign by two, take the integer part, add one, and count that many signs from the sign itself (for odd signs; even signs count from the 7th).
vargas.note: Carries the highest vimshopaka weight. Requires a birth time accurate to under a minute — PocketAstro withholds D60 unless the time source is a record.

reading.above_15: excellent — the graha delivers across the board
reading.below_5: the promise does not reach the ground

varga_dignity_names.note: A graha's own or exalted status repeated across N vargas earns these classical titles; more repetitions means a more reliable promise.

practice_rules: Never read a varga as a standalone chart. It refines the D1's statement; it cannot contradict it.
A graha in the same sign in D1 and D9 is vargottama and delivers what it promises.
Read D9 for marriage and for the real strength of every graha; D10 for career; D7 for children; D4 for property; D24 for education; D20 for practice.
Divisional charts amplify birth-time error. D1 and D9 tolerate a few minutes; D60 tolerates seconds.
The varga lagna matters as much as the varga positions — check the lagna lord in every varga you read.

birth_time_accuracy.D1: ±4 minutes changes the lagna near a sign boundary
birth_time_accuracy.D60: ±30 seconds moves a shashtiamsha — requires a recorded time
